principle: Measurement makes a change eligible; a named human approval is still required. No gate autonomously generates or publishes content.

content.scope_limit: At most 2 evidence-backed RU/EN pages per approved cycle; no city-product matrix.

geo.scope_limit: One proven market and one language per approved cycle; no synthetic city expansion.

merchant.scope_limit: Submit only verified sellable products; unavailable or price-less products remain excluded.

openapi.scope_limit: Read-only catalog/specification endpoints first; no write operations.

mcp.scope_limit: Read-only tools over approved OpenAPI fields; no purchasing, messaging or content mutation.

failure_rule.provider_status_skip: exclude provider from averages and hold if success-rate gate fails
failure_rule.provider_status_fail: score remains null; investigate and rerun, never coerce to zero
